newsitem.title: USA: Fed injects reserves via 5-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed injects reserves via 5-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system during its usual intervention period Wednesday via a round of five-day fixed system repurchase agreements.

The action was not completely unexpected but some economists thought the Fed would remain out this session and instead inject via four-day systems on Thursday to carry it through the current two-week maintenance period.
The federal funds rate was trading at 5-13/16 percent, near the current target level of 5.25 percent.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663
